notes: Single-stage debugging: a release (-O2) build of a custom first-fit free-list pool allocator segfaults because the split path leaves the remainder block's free-list link unwritten, so it inherits stale payload bytes; the next allocation that walks past it dereferences garbage. The agent must diagnose with gdb/objdump/repro workloads, fix only /app/forge.c (main.c and Makefile are hash-protected), rebuild, and satisfy an independent reference simulation of the driver checksum on the visible workload plus three hidden workloads (reuse-heavy, shrink-split, churn) that all reproduce the crash on the shipped binary. Exercises C-7991a29a at medium. Rubric nonzero for tool_breadth (debuggers/build), reasoning_depth and debugging_ambiguity (heap bookkeeping corruption), hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness (exact checksum).
